products.body_html:
*The Smart Gateway Lite is required for all Mango Power S PIPV systems outside Utah to enable Zero-Export functionality. Use is subject to local grid interconnection approval.

  • Rapid Zero-Export Response：Ultra-fast ≤0.25s response helps prevent unwanted power backflow to the grid.
  • Smart Wi-Fi Connectivity：Monitor and manage your system anytime through the App in real time.
  • Error-Proof Installation：Automatically detects CT and phase errors for easier setup and reliable operation.
  • Flexible Plug-and-Play Design：Supports both plug-in and hard-wired installation for different home setups.
